title: The Dragon and the Tower
description: A couples arc exploring the anger-withdrawal cycle. One partner becomes the dragon (fire, pursuit), the other retreats to the tower (stone, distance). Both are protecting the same wound.

acts.title: Fire at the Gate
acts.description: The dragon circles the tower, breathing fire. The tower grows taller. Neither understands they are both afraid.

acts.title: The Crack in the Stone
acts.description: A crack appears in the tower wall. Through it, the dragon sees not an enemy but a frightened child. The fire dims.

acts.title: The Shared Flame
acts.description: The dragon lands. The tower opens. They sit together by a fire that warms without burning.
